method: Procedural high-density geometry with explicit evidence grades. Museum records and published excavation material determine attested features; missing architecture is labelled interpretive.
corrections_from_v3: EA1107 is modelled as a bifacial Hathor capital with two principal faces, not four faces.
Only one of the four reconstructed hall columns carries the specifically documented north-side symbols.
The palmiform capital was changed from a horizontal umbrella shape to closely bundled, upward palm leaves based on EA1065 photographs.
Papyrus shafts use visible bundled stems and carved stone tie bands rather than detached coloured dots.
Bright blue and black attachments were removed from the Hathor capitals; structural parts remain red granite with restrained pigment traces.
